[{"insert":"Goblet Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat

Putting your back foot up on a bench pushes most of the work onto your front leg. Holding the weight at your chest in the goblet position keeps your chest tall and drives the load into that front quad. Keep your front heel planted and lower with control. Pair it with the clamshell side plank hip thrust to target the sides of your hips.
"}]
